sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: Bivonaea lutea is a small annual mustard-family plant native to the central Mediterranean. It bears a basal rosette, small yellow four-petalled flowers and short flattened seed pods (silicles). The authoritative taxonomic sources consulted did not provide a dependable species-specific height.

sections.title: Uses and image
sections.text: No reliable food use or toxicity information was located, so neither should be inferred from its relation to edible mustards. The plate's rosette, yellow flowers and flattened pods are consistent with a small Brassicaceae.
